package bolo

// Error is the type of every failure Bolo reports (API C10, §7). Each one is a
// constant, never a variable another realm could reassign (C6), and its text
// starts with its copy key, which a client turns into a message (UI spec §8).
type Error string

func (e Error) Error() string { return string(e) }

const (
	ErrNotFound           Error = "err.not_found: no such campaign or receipt"
	ErrNotUserCall        Error = "err.use_wallet: not a direct transaction from a wallet"
	ErrSessionKey         Error = "err.master_key: a session key can't do this"
	ErrWrongDenom         Error = "err.amount: only ugnot is accepted"
	ErrBadAmount          Error = "err.amount: the amount is wrong"
	ErrDepositMismatch    Error = "err.amount: send exactly the creation deposit"
	ErrPaused             Error = "err.paused: Bolo is paused"
	ErrNotOrganizer       Error = "err.not_allowed: only the organizer can do this"
	ErrNotBeneficiary     Error = "err.not_allowed: only the beneficiary can do this"
	ErrNotAdmin           Error = "err.not_allowed: only the admin can do this"
	ErrCampaignClosed     Error = "err.state: the campaign is closed"
	ErrCampaignSettled    Error = "err.state: the campaign is settled"
	ErrBondSlashed        Error = "err.state: the bond was slashed"
	ErrNoBond             Error = "err.state: there is no bond to slash"
	ErrHoldEnded          Error = "err.state: the bond's hold has ended"
	ErrWrongMode          Error = "err.mode: not for this custody mode"
	ErrNothingToRefund    Error = "err.refund: nothing to refund"
	ErrRefundWindowClosed Error = "err.refund: no refund window is open"
	ErrExitOpen           Error = "err.exit_open: the exit window is open"
	ErrNotClosable        Error = "err.not_yet: the campaign can't be closed yet"
	ErrNotFinalizable     Error = "err.not_yet: the campaign can't be finalized yet"
	ErrNothingToWithdraw  Error = "err.withdraw: nothing to withdraw"
	ErrTitle              Error = "err.text: the title's length is out of bounds"
	ErrDescription        Error = "err.text: the story's length is out of bounds"
	ErrMessage            Error = "err.text: the message's length is out of bounds"
	ErrUpdate             Error = "err.text: the update's length is out of bounds"
	ErrNotice             Error = "err.text: the notice's length is out of bounds"
	ErrImage              Error = "err.text: the photo or its description is invalid"
	ErrMarkup             Error = "err.markup: a story or update holds no image and no raw HTML"
	ErrBeneficiary        Error = "err.input: invalid beneficiary"
	ErrCategory           Error = "err.input: unknown category"
	ErrMode               Error = "err.input: invalid custody mode"
	ErrDeadline           Error = "err.input: invalid deadline"
	ErrGoal               Error = "err.input: invalid goal"
	ErrSetting            Error = "err.input: invalid setting"
	ErrSunset             Error = "err.sunset: this version takes no new campaigns"
	ErrCapReached         Error = "err.cap: the campaign's escrow cap is reached"
	ErrBooksMismatch      Error = "err.internal: the books exceed the bank (INV-1)"
)

files.body:
package bolo

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// Each error and its copy key, as API §7 pairs them; every key resolves to a
// message in UI spec §8.
var errorKeys = map[Error]string{
	ErrNotFound:           "err.not_found",
	ErrNotUserCall:        "err.use_wallet",
	ErrSessionKey:         "err.master_key",
	ErrWrongDenom:         "err.amount",
	ErrBadAmount:          "err.amount",
	ErrDepositMismatch:    "err.amount",
	ErrPaused:             "err.paused",
	ErrNotOrganizer:       "err.not_allowed",
	ErrNotBeneficiary:     "err.not_allowed",
	ErrNotAdmin:           "err.not_allowed",
	ErrCampaignClosed:     "err.state",
	ErrCampaignSettled:    "err.state",
	ErrBondSlashed:        "err.state",
	ErrNoBond:             "err.state",
	ErrHoldEnded:          "err.state",
	ErrWrongMode:          "err.mode",
	ErrNothingToRefund:    "err.refund",
	ErrRefundWindowClosed: "err.refund",
	ErrExitOpen:           "err.exit_open",
	ErrNotClosable:        "err.not_yet",
	ErrNotFinalizable:     "err.not_yet",
	ErrNothingToWithdraw:  "err.withdraw",
	ErrTitle:              "err.text",
	ErrDescription:        "err.text",
	ErrMessage:            "err.text",
	ErrUpdate:             "err.text",
	ErrNotice:             "err.text",
	ErrImage:              "err.text",
	ErrMarkup:             "err.markup",
	ErrBeneficiary:        "err.input",
	ErrCategory:           "err.input",
	ErrMode:               "err.input",
	ErrDeadline:           "err.input",
	ErrGoal:               "err.input",
	ErrSetting:            "err.input",
	ErrSunset:             "err.sunset",
	ErrCapReached:         "err.cap",
	ErrBooksMismatch:      "err.internal",
}

// TestErrorsLeadWithCopyKeys: every error of API §7 starts with its own copy key,
// then ": " and a message (API C10). The static check refuses an Error without a
// key; this pins which key each one has.
func TestErrorsLeadWithCopyKeys(t *testing.T) {
	if len(errorKeys) != 38 {
		t.Errorf("%d errors, API §7 has 38", len(errorKeys))
	}
	for e, want := range errorKeys {
		key, msg, ok := strings.Cut(string(e), ": ")
		if !ok || key != want || msg == "" {
			t.Errorf("%q doesn't start with %s", string(e), want)
		}
	}
}

package bolo

import "strconv"

// The events Bolo emits (API §6), for the web app's indexer. Their attributes are
// strings.
const (
	evCampaignCreated     = "CampaignCreated"
	evBondPosted          = "BondPosted"
	evBondReleased        = "BondReleased"
	evDonated             = "Donated"
	evWithdrawn           = "Withdrawn"
	evRefunded            = "Refunded"
	evUpdatePosted        = "UpdatePosted"
	evClosed              = "Closed"
	evSettled             = "Settled"
	evDelisted            = "Delisted"
	evRelisted            = "Relisted"
	evNoticeSet           = "NoticeSet"
	evStraysSwept         = "StraysSwept"
	evImageHidden         = "ImageHidden"
	evMessageHidden       = "MessageHidden"
	evParamsChanged       = "ParamsChanged"
	evAdminProposed       = "AdminProposed"
	evAdminChanged        = "AdminChanged"
	evPaused              = "Paused"
	evUnpaused            = "Unpaused"
	evTipRecipientChanged = "TipRecipientChanged"
	evMinDonationChanged  = "MinDonationChanged"
	evPresetsChanged      = "PresetsChanged"
	evEscrowCapChanged    = "EscrowCapChanged"
	evCategoryAdded       = "CategoryAdded"
	evSunset              = "Sunset"
)

// itoa formats an amount, a timestamp or a sequence number as an attribute.
func itoa(n int64) string { return strconv.FormatInt(n, 10) }

# garden/v4's module path. Deploy status is deliberately NOT recorded in this file, and
# neither is a claim about whether anyone has decided to deploy it.
#
# This file ships on chain exactly as written the moment garden/v4 is deployed, and a realm
# cannot be edited afterwards. garden/v2/gnomod.toml said "NOT deployed" in this same spot,
# was deployed hours later, and now carries that false line permanently on chain -- see that
# file's own corrected comment, DECISIONS.md ("Do not write deployment status into a file
# that gets deployed") and STATUS.md:142-145. Whether and when this has been deployed lives
# in the repo root's DECISIONS.md and STATUS.md, both of which can still be corrected after
# the fact; the authority above both is the chain itself (`vm/qfile` on this path).
#
# The module path mirrors garden/garden.gno, garden/v2/garden.gno, hollowmere/v1 and
# arena/v1: the deploy key's own address namespace, not a name, because `gnotchi` is not
# registerable today (r/sys/names, team-held controller -- see realms/garden/NOTES.md).
# Whoever deploys this should re-check that this path is still right first.
#
# THREE THINGS TO CHECK BEFORE DEPLOYING THIS, all recorded in DESIGN.md and none
# discoverable from this line alone:
#
#  0. THE THREE SALE CONSTANTS AT THE VERY TOP OF garden.gno -- saleFeeRecipient,
#     saleFeeRateBps (basis points of the price) and saleFeeFloorUgnot (ugnot) -- are the
#     owner's decision of 2026-10-11 for the onyx testnet, and init() still refuses to run if
#     any of them is edited to a value that cannot work (DESIGN.md section 9.7). Re-read them
#     before deploying: once deployed they can never change, because there is no fee setter,
#     no steward and no treasury change, on purpose (section 9.6). They are testnet values;
#     a mainnet deploy would be a fresh realm with fresh numbers decided then.
#  1. adminAddress in garden.gno is a compiled-in constant and is today the DISPOSABLE
#     TESTNET deploy key (DECISIONS.md: "Never a mainnet key."). It is correct for onyx and
#     wrong for anywhere real. Change that one constant before deploying anywhere that
#     matters -- it cannot be changed afterwards, and there is no admin-transfer function.
#  2. This realm imports NOTHING of this project's own. Unlike arena/v1, which cannot
#     resolve a battle unless garden/v2 is live at the exact path it imports, garden/v4 has
#     no cross-realm dependency at all and can be deployed to any chain on its own. The
#     consequence runs the other way and is in v3's DESIGN.md section 6.3: the already-deployed
#     arena/v1 imports garden/v2 immutably, so a gnome adopted here cannot use arena/v1.
#  3. THIS REPLACES garden/v3 ONLY WHILE garden/v3 HAS NO GNOMES. v3 is deployed at block
#     336496 and TotalGnomes() read 0 on 2026-10-12. The moment one person adopts on v3 the
#     cheap replacement in realms/garden/v4/DESIGN.md section 1 stops being cheap: re-check
#     TotalGnomes() on v3 (read-only vm/qeval) immediately before deploying this.
#  4. numEyes and numNoses in garden.gno are 10 and 8, SPRITES.md's Phase 1 counts, and they
#     are the face catalogue's size FOR EVER once deployed. Confirm the art's catalogue has
#     exactly that many eye and nose parts, in a frozen order, before deploying.
module = "gno.land/r/g1r4aw43kagaaquhegxw6xr346h9f2qu2ezf0jar/garden/v4"
gno = "0.9"
